snippet.title: Ogre Stampede - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
First trailer for the game Ogre Stampede. A physics-based horde survivor-like game with incremental progress and no perma death. You play as an Ogre trying to become the new chieftain but there are swarms of other trolls and ogres that also want to become the new leader. In the stomping grounds you push and shove each other around and the characters bounce around like in a pinball game. In this free for all arena, the last one standing wins.

The game will release on Steam in 2027, wishlist it now to get notified when play-tests, demos and the full release becomes available. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4991660/Ogre_Stampede/
